newsitem.title: USA: Entergy shutting River Bend La. nuclear plant.
newsitem.headline: Entergy shutting River Bend La. nuclear plant.

text.p: Entergy Corp is in the process of shutting its 936 megawatt (MW) River Bend nuclear power plant for pump repairs, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Friday.
Restart for the unit, in St Francisville, Louisiana, is estimated for Tuesday, July 29, the commission said in its daily plant status report.
The unit is already ramping down power output, and was reported to be at 60 percent of its rated capacity early this morning. It had been running at full power early Thursday.
The NRC said the repairs would be carried out on a leaking recirculation pump seal.
Entergy's 1,075 MW Waterford 3 nuclear generating station, in Taft, La., was still in hot standby and preparing to restart, the NRC said.
The unit was shut April 11 for maintenance and refueling.
